state_interpretation.controller_transition: xdriver.driver_req changes from ~0 to 15 V within the final repeated-time group; pwm is already 2.42956 V, while gate, q, en, fault, and pcl_hold remain effectively unchanged.
state_interpretation.electrical_paths: i(Lboost) and i(Vchannel) rise smoothly together around 181.3 to 182.0 A; vd/vb remain near 384.17 V and diode-sense currents remain sub-microampere.

hypotheses.statement: The late xdriver.driver_req bridge transition at the final repeated timestamps triggers a hidden mixed-signal algebraic event even though gate, q, en, fault, and pcl_hold do not change.
hypotheses.disproof_experiment: Repeat from the same saved endpoint state with only the driver-request transition held at its pre-transition value; unchanged collapse timing would disprove H1.

hypotheses.statement: The near-DC ~182 A channel path with ~384 V reservoir nodes and ideal zero-volt sense probes is already numerically stiff; the branch label identifies the Newton failure location rather than a controller cause.
hypotheses.disproof_experiment: Repeat from the same saved endpoint state with the sense-probe topology given a controlled small finite impedance while preserving the electrical state; unchanged collapse timing would disprove H2.

scope: Exact 256-row endpoint tail only; not whole-run maxima, fault-response evidence, or normal-prefix acceptance.
